locations.title: Ancestral Worship
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Golldir outside [Hillgrund's Tomb](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3328)  

**Description:** Help Golldir vanquish a necromancer that has defiled the tomb of his ancestors.  Protect Golldir (optional).  

**Reward:** Gain [Golldir](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=37044) as a follower if he survives the quest.

**Description:** Investigate a string of murders in the city and bring the suspect to justice.  

**Reward:** Necromancer amulet

**Description:** Gather ingredients to repair the phial

**Reward:** The White Phial

**Reward:** Bard's College membership

**Description:** Join a bandit gang and rob an Imperial ship

locations.title: The Man Who Cried Wolf
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Falk Firebeard (usually found in the Blue Palace, he is the Jarl's Steward)

**Description:** Investigate [Wolfskull Cave](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4787)

locations.title: The Wolf Queen Awakened
locations.description:
**Location:** This quest is given via a letter from Falk Firebeard delivered to the player by courier sometime after the completion of [The Man Who Cried Wolf](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=53070)

**Prerequisite:** Reach level 10+ and complete [The Man Who Cried Wolf](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=53070)

**Description:** Defeat The Wolf Queen in a tomb underneath Solitude

**Reward:** Shield of Solitude

locations.title: Forbidden Legend
locations.description:
**Location:** Begin quest by reading a copy of the book _Lost Legends_ found throughout Skyrim (there is one at this marker in [Farengar Secret-Fire](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=36339)'s library in [Dragonsreach](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3037))

**Description:** Investigate the Gauldur Legend which begins at [Folgunthur](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3106)

**Reward:** The Gauldur Amulet, Gauldur Blackbow, Staff of Jyrik Gauldurson, Gauldur Blackblade

locations.title: Laid to Rest
locations.description:
**Location:** Begin quest by speaking with the innkeeper about the burned down house in Morthal

**Description:** Investigate the deaths of two people from the burned house

locations.title: Rising at Dawn
locations.description:
**Location:** This quest obtained by speaking to any bartender in Skyrim, about Falion in [Morthal](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4059), after the player has become a vampire.

**Prerequiste:** Become a vampire

**Description:** Find a cure for vampirism (this quest can be redone as many times as needed if the player becomes a vampire again)

**Reward:** Cured of vampirism

locations.title: Silenced Tongues
locations.description:
**Location:** Begin quest by picking up the journal titled _Heddic's Notes_ on the ground immediately after entering [Volunruud](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4746).  Or enter the Elder's Cairn in the depths of Volunruud.

**Description:** Recover the ceremonial weapons and enter Elder's Cairn where a [word wall](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=17741) and various loot await

locations.title: The Pale Lady
locations.description:
**Location:** Begin quest by talking with Eisa Blackthorn outside of [Frostmere Crypt](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3190).  Or if Eisa is killed, loot her body and read her journal.

**Description:** Recover the stolen sword

**Reward:** The Pale Blade (if The Pale Lady is killed)

locations.title: A Scroll for Anska
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Anska shortly after entering [High Gate Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3318)

**Description:** Help Anska recover the scroll from the Dragon Priest Vokun

**Reward:** [Dragon Priest Mask Vokun](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=11185)

locations.title: Evil in Waiting
locations.description:
**Location:** The spirit Valdar will engage the player upon entering the [Valthume Vestible](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4732).  Help Valdar to begin the quest.

**Description:** Summon and defeat the Dragon Priest Hevnoraak

**Reward:** [Dragon Priest Mask Hevnoraak](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=11181)

locations.title: The Forsworn Conspiracy
locations.description:
**Location:** After first entering the city of Markarth, the player will witness an attack by a Forsworn zealot.  Shortly afterwards, the Breton Eltrys will give the player a note to meet him in the Shrine of Talos.  Speak with Eltrys at the [shrine](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4356) to begin the quest.

**Description:** Investigate the Forsworn presence in Markarth

locations.description:
**Location:** Quest begins immediately after the player is arrested and jailed in [Cidhna Mine](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=2698), following quest [The Forsworn Conspiracy](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=53254)

**Prerequiste:** Complete quest [The Forsworn Conspiracy](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=53254), and get arrested.  If player resists arrest during prerequisite quest, this quest will not begin until the player speaks to a Markarth guard and gets arrested.

**Description:** Side with the Forsworn OR the Silver-Blood Family, and escape Cidhna Mine

**Reward:** Silver-Blood Family Ring OR Armor of the Old Gods

locations.title: The Heart of Dibella
locations.description:
**Location:** Quest is begun by entering into the [Temple of Dibella](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4591)'s Inner Sanctum.  For trespassing, the Dibella priestess Hamal will ask the player to complete a task, of which the player must accept, else this quest will be unavailable.

**Description:** Bring the chosen Sybil of Dibella to Hamal 

**Reward:** _Agent of Dibella_ ability

locations.title: The Lost Expedition
locations.description:
**Location:** Retrieve and read Alethius's Notes next to his body near the end of the [Nchuand-Zel Excavation Site](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=53257) to begin this quest

**Description:** Delve into the Dwermer ruins Nchuand-Zel and uncover what became of the lost expedition party

locations.title: Infiltration
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Stalleo at the camp just adjacent to [Treva's Watch](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4713) near the bridge

**Description:** Help Stalleo reclaim his family castle from bandits

**Reward:** Detect Life Spell Tome

locations.title: Kyne's Sacred Trials
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Froki Whetted-Blade inside [Froki's Shack](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3184)

**Description:** Slay various ghostly beasts throughout Skyrim 

**Reward:** Kyne's Token

locations.title: Repentance
locations.description:
**Location:** Illia will engage the player upon first entering [Darklight Tower](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=2979).  Help her to begin the quest.

**Description:** Reach the top of [Darklight Tower](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=2979), clearing enemies on the way, to defeat Illia's mother

**Reward:** [Illia](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=53489) as a follower, Staff of Hag's Wrath (looted from Silvia)

locations.title: Siege on the Dragon Cult
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Captain Valmir at the camp just outside [Forelhost](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3109) and help him with his mission

**Description:** Fight your way through [Forelhost](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3109) and retrieve the dragon priest mask.

**Reward:** [Dragon Priest Mask Rahgot](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=11184)

locations.title: The Book of Love
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Dinya Balu inside the [Temple of Mara](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4594) in [Riften](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4257)

**Description:** Complete various requests in the name of Mara throughout Skyrim

**Reward:** Agent of Mara ability, Amulet of Mara

locations.title: Unfathomable Depths
locations.description:
**Location:** Find From-Deepest-Fathoms who circumambulates the [Riften Fishery](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4262) and speak with her to begin quest

**Prerequisite:** Level 14+

**Description:** Return the Dwarven lexicon given by From-Deepest-Depths to [Avanchnzel](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=2547)

**Reward:** Ancient Knowledge ability

locations.title: Delayed Burial
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with the jester Cicero near the broken down cart in the road or with Vantus Loreius at [Loreius Farm](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3981)

**Prerequisite:** The player must not be a Dark Brotherhood member.  This quest becomes unavailable after completion of the Dark Brotherhood quest _With Friends Like These..._

**Description:** Convince Loreius to fix Cicero's cart wheel OR report Cicero to the guard patrolling the road near the cart at Loreius's behest

locations.title: In My Time of Need
locations.description:
**Location:** [Whiterun](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4761)

**Prerequisite:** Begin the main quest _Dragon Rising_

**Description:** Help Alik'r warriors find Saadia who is in [The Bannered Mare](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4615) OR help Saadia by killing Kematu and his mercenaries in the [Swindler's Den](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4587)

locations.title: Missing in Action
locations.description:
**Location:** After witnessing an argument between two men from clan Battle-Born with [Fralia Gray-Mane](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=35247) near her market stall, speak with Fralia in her home.

**Description:** Rescue Fralia's son Thorald from imprisonment in [Northwatch Keep](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4092)

locations.title: The Blessings of Nature
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Danica Pure-Spring inside the [Temple of Kynareth](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4592)

**Description:** Restore the Gildergreen tree in Whiterun to its former beauty by traveling to [Orphan Rock](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=4150) to retrieve a weapon that can extract sap from the Eldergleam tree in [Eldergleam Sanctuary](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=3063)

**Reward:** Nettlebane, one point Restoration, [Danica Pure-Spring](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=53864) as a Restoration trainer

locations.title: The Golden Claw
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with [Lucan Valerius](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=36343)

**Description:** Retrieve the stolen Golden Claw from [Bleak Falls Barrow](https://mapgenie.io/skyrim/maps/skyrim?locationIds=2609).  Note that this quest follows the bulk of the quest objectives as main quest _Bleak Falls Barrow_ and both can be done simultaneously

**Reward:** Camilla Valerius becomes available for marriage
